# Felucca's package and update-protocol code

`fm1pkg.js` and `fm1ota.js` are unmodified copies from [Felucca](https://github.com/hugelton/Felucca), tag
`v1.1.5` (commit `276f72a`), `web/`. Copyright (C) 2026 Leo Kuroshita (@kurogedelic), Hügelton Instruments.
Licence: GPL-3.0-only (see each file's header).

They are copied here because the installer site is built from this repository alone (the Felucca clone next
to it is not part of it). This is the code every install on the test FM-1 has gone through; do not edit it.
To update: copy the two files again from a newer Felucca and re-run `web/test_installer.js` and the site's tests.
